scope.summary: Local translation is offline for installed pairs; cloud translation requires visible content egress and provider provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh translation-egress-suite evidence proves the complete requirement: Local translation is offline for installed pairs; cloud translation requires visible content egress and provider provenance.

[positive] Execute every named supported behavior and prove from canonical state: Local translation is offline for installed pairs; cloud translation requires visible content egress and provider provenance.

[negative] Malformed, unsupported, stale, unauthorized, or boundary-crossing variants cannot produce false success for: Local translation is offline for installed pairs; cloud translation requires visible content egress and provider provenance.

[failure_recovery] Interrupt and restart at each durable boundary; completed truth is preserved and the requirement converges without duplication: Local translation is offline for installed pairs; cloud translation requires visible content egress and provider provenance.

[concurrency] Parallel actors/jobs retain isolated identity, bounded execution, deterministic conflict handling, and attributable receipts while satisfying: Local translation is offline for installed pairs; cloud translation requires visible content egress and provider provenance.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
Legacy Stage code (WP-12) must not silently constrain this MT (STAGE-DEC-017).
Do not duplicate ArtifactStore, WP-1 ToolGate/process/promotion, or Loom authority.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
